title: Non-isomorphism of reduced free group $C^\ast$-algebras
summary: Using a new approach involving embedding spaces in II$_1$ factors with plenty of freely independent Haar unitaries, we prove that $C^\ast_r(\mathbb{F}_n)\ncong C^\ast_r(\mathbb{F}_m)$ for $n \neq m$. This recovers the seminal result of Pimsner and Voiculescu with a short new proof.
